name: Samsung Galaxy A06 5G (Demo Unit)
shortDescription: Open-box demo (display) unit of the Samsung Galaxy A06 5G. It has a 17.13 cm (6.7 inch) 90 Hz HD+ display, MediaTek Dimensity 6300, 50 MP main camera and 5,000 mAh battery.
description:
This is a demo (display) unit of the Samsung Galaxy A06 5G that was used for in-store demonstration, sold open-box at a lower price. It may show light signs of handling. Please contact us before ordering if you'd like to know its exact condition, the accessories included and the remaining manufacturer warranty.

The Samsung Galaxy A06 5G has a 17.13 cm (6.7 inch) HD+ PLS LCD display with a refresh rate of up to 90 Hz. It runs on the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 processor with 4 GB or 6 GB RAM and 64 GB or 128 GB storage, and takes a microSD card of up to 1.5 TB.

There are two rear cameras (50 MP and 2 MP) and an 8 MP front camera. The phone has a 5,000 mAh battery (typical) with support for 25 W fast charging, an IP54 rating for dust and splash resistance, and a 3.5 mm headphone jack.

Samsung lists 4 generations of OS upgrades for this model and security updates until 31 March 2030.
